faq.q: How much does Kwartler Manus charge?
faq.a: Kwartler Manus publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Kwartler Manus offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Kwartler Manus publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Kwartler Manus have offices?
faq.a: Kwartler Manus publishes two offices, in Philadelphia and Cherry Hill Township. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Kwartler Manus?
faq.a: Kwartler Manus names 24 attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Pennsylvania does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Kwartler Manus publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Kwartler Manus publishes 78 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Kwartler Manus?
faq.a: Kwartler Manus scores 59 and sits at Verified. Passed: website and footprint. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure, discipline and entity registration. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
